Frequently Asked Questions

How long does it take to get a reply?
We reply within 1–2 school days. If you email us at hello@pasagamit.ph, expect a response from our student support team.
Is contacting support free?
Yes. Reaching out to PasaGamit support is always free for verified students.
How do I report a scam or suspicious listing?
Use the Report button on any listing, or email report@pasagamit.ph. We act within 24 hours.
Can I request a feature?
Absolutely. We are built by students, for students — send your suggestions and we will add them to the roadmap.
